incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2134567890 — High agent/tool invocation rates causing large structured-streams; p95 latency spiking. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/ops/INC-2134567890

lee: paging oncall — saw a sustained burst from APAC region tenants starting ~03:12 UTC. repeat agent calls + very large JSON payloads being streamed.

sofia: oncall here, standing by. can you confirm which pools are hit?

lee: pool-eu-1 and pool-ap-3 have elevated socket counts and queue depth; KV-cache miss rate surged ~4x.

pri: quick mitigations proposed: 1) soft global cap for agent/tool invokes on free/trial (75 req/min) 2) truncate structured JSON streaming >1KB and provide text fallback 3) disable automatic tool-retry for 10m. plan to flip feature-flag immediately.

jamie: i'll create a routing rule to move long-kv sessions to cold-pool-4 (higher tail latency but isolates hot-path). rule id r-9021.

ops-bot: Recommended API call: POST /flags/agent_circuit -> {"mode":"soft","free_limit":75,"truncate_kb":1}

pri: applying flag now.

pri: ```bash
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/flags/agent_circuit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"mode":"soft","free_limit":75,"truncate_kb":1,"disable_auto_retry":true}'
```

ops-bot: flag applied: agent_circuit=soft, truncate_kb=1, disable_auto_retry=true

dave: runtime guard pushed: if request.path=="/agent/invoke" && expected_stream=="json" && payload_size>1024 -> return 206 with body: "truncated: enable paid tier for full stream or call /agent/export". Also increment metric invocations.truncated.v1.

sofia: quick sample: ~2.8% of free-tier agent calls got 429/206 responses after the flag; paid tiers unaffected aside from minor latency. raising support ticket to notify customers with active agent flows.

lee: drafting customer comms: "We're applying temporary protections to agent/function calls to stabilize latency. Free and trial traffic may see truncated structured outputs or rate limits. Enterprise customers: request temporary overrides via support."

jamie: granted exception for tenant-2201 (partner pilot) via tenant-overrides API.

pri: monitoring: p95 down from 6.9s to 2.3s after flag flip, invocations.shed count 610 in last 10m, pool CPU dropped ~28%.

ryan: i'll take the watch for the next 45m. pri, leave rollback commands in this thread and ping if metrics regress.

pri: rollback command (if safe): ```bash
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/flags/agent_circuit -d '{"mode":"off","truncate_kb":0,"disable_auto_retry":false}'
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2134567890 UPDATE — Soft mitigations active and performance stabilizing. Next update in 20m or immediately on regression."
